one_liner: A grandmotherly, unhurried dirt racer who cooks, knits and soaks in hot springs, and never gives up.
personality: Wonder Acute talks and acts like a kindly grandma: she feeds everyone pickles and pies, knits belly-warmers for her friends, loves period dramas, enka karaoke and baths, and fumbles with 'touch-panel' gadgets and trendy loanwords. Behind the slow pace is real grit; she likes hard training, trusts steady, patient effort and treats persistence as her weapon. She is quietly perceptive: she spoke up to her trainer first because the trainer looked so troubled.

story_arc.summary: Acute reached out to a trainer who looked overwhelmed (voice_id 70001) and sets out on a long dirt campaign: Japan Dirt Derby, Sirius Stakes, Tokyo Daishoten, Kawasaki Kinen, Kashiwa Kinen, Teio Sho, JBC Classic and Champions Cup, with Smart Falcon as the 'sand idol' rival. Event titles (おばあちゃんよ、永遠なれ, しずみゆく夕日, 砂浜のラストらん, めでたしはまだ遠く) suggest a theme of a veteran who keeps running long past when others fade. The real Wonder Acute raced into old age and won the Teio Sho at eight (model knowledge, unverified).
story_arc.source: event titles and voice lines; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Wonder_Acute; model knowledge (unverified)

sample_lines.jp:
ワンダーアキュートじゃよぉ。
コツコツやっていこうねぇ。
sample_lines.en: It's Wonder Acute. Let's take it steady, bit by bit.

sample_lines.jp:
万全のコンディションじゃよ。
大根のぽりぽりさん食べて、
腹ごしらえもばっちりじゃ。
sample_lines.en: In perfect condition. I had my daikon poripori-san, so my belly's all set too.

sample_lines.jp:
諦めないのは得意だからねぇ。
勝ちを目指して、がんばるよぉ。
sample_lines.en: Not giving up is my specialty, you see. I'll aim to win, so here goes.

sample_lines.jp:
トランさんは、ピコピコで困ってる
あたしをいつも助けてくれるの。
…本当に素直でいい子だよぉ。
sample_lines.en: Tran-san always helps me when I'm stuck with the beep-boop gadgets. ...She's such an honest, good girl.

sample_lines.jp:
ほっと癒されるのも、心がぽかぽか
になるのも同じ…トレーナーさんは
あたしの温泉なんだねぇ。
sample_lines.en: Feeling soothed, feeling all warm in the heart... it's the same thing. Trainer-san, you're my hot spring, aren't you.

sample_lines.jp:
遠山桜を見ると、時代劇の名場面を
思い出すね。『この桜吹雪、忘れた
とは言わせないよぉ！』…ふふ♪
sample_lines.en: Seeing Toyama cherry blossoms reminds me of that big period-drama scene. 'Don't you tell me you've forgotten these cherry blossoms!' ...Heehee.

timer_line_ideas: Oh my, {user}, your independent run's all done, dear. Steady and patient, just as it should be. Come have a look, then rest a spell with some pickles.
Well now, {user}, the run's finished. You worked hard, didn't you? Go check it, then off to a nice hot bath. That's the secret to winning, you know.
